title: The absolute arithmetic continuum and the unification of all numbers great and small
note: Demonstrates that $\mathbf{No}$ contains all real-closed ordered fields as subfields, including the hyperreals $^*\mathbb{R}$ and the Hahn series $\mathbb{R}((t^G))$ for any divisible ordered abelian group $G$.  Justifies embedding every analytic regime into a single surreal ambient.
